derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4314 (προσφάγιον) and G5315 (προσφάγιον);
strongs_def: something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare G3795 (προσφάγιον))
it_def:
1) qualcosa da mangiare con il pane
   1a) di pesce bollito o cotto a fuoco vivo
